name: io.github.gowinder/geminicost
title: Gemini Cost Simulator
description: Gemini 4 agent-run cost simulator over MCP: true per-turn totals vs naive estimates.

tools.name: estimate_agent_run
tools.description: Turn-by-turn cost of a Gemini 4 agent run: every turn re-sends the growing context as input, thinking tokens are billed at the output rate. Returns the rates in force on the chosen date, the simulated total, the naive first-turn × turns estimate and their multiplier. Before the 2026-12-01 price change it also returns afterIncrease: the same run priced at the announced 2026-12-01 rates.

thinkingLevel.description: Thinking budget. Thinking tokens are billed at the output price: off = 0×, low ≈0.5×, medium ≈1.5×, high ≈3× the visible output tokens.

turns.description: Number of turns (separate API calls) in the run.

initialContextTokens.description: System prompt, tool definitions and documents sent on turn 1.

contextGrowthPerTurn.description: Net history added after each completed turn; billed from turn 2 onward.

userToolInputTokensPerTurn.description: New user/tool content billed on top of the context each turn.

outputTokensPerTurn.description: Visible answer tokens per turn, excluding thinking.

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) that selects the price segment in force that day. Defaults to today (UTC).

tools.name: get_gemini_pricing
tools.description: Price segment in force on a date for every recorded Gemini 4 model, or for one model: input and output USD per 1,000,000 tokens, the segment start and end dates and its status. Segments marked announced-unpriced have no published values and are reported as such.

modelId.description: Restrict the answer to one model. Omit for all recorded models.

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) that selects the price segment in force that day. Defaults to today (UTC).
